result.stdout:
Description:
  Finds code, package references and files a .NET solution no longer uses.

Usage:
  dotnet-deadcode [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  scan              Report code nothing reaches from an entry point or a test.
  oracle            Delete each finding in memory and report the ones that break a compilation.
  references        Report ProjectReferences whose assembly the project source never uses.
  packages          Report PackageReferences whose assemblies the project source never uses.
  files             Report .cs files no project compiles and embedded resources no source names.
  explain <symbol>  Print the chain of references that keeps a symbol alive, or say nothing reaches it.
  fix               Delete findings that compile without them, then rebuild; put everything back if the build breaks.

Description:
  Report code nothing reaches from an entry point or a test.

Usage:
  dotnet-deadcode scan [options]

Options:
  --include-public                   Also report public members of libraries that nothing in the solution uses.
  --json                             Write the report as JSON to standard output.
  --sarif                            Write the report as SARIF 2.1.0 to standard output.
  --baseline <baseline>              Report only findings this baseline file does not hold.
  --write-baseline <write-baseline>  Write the current findings to this file as the new baseline, and exit 0.
  -p, --path <path>                  Directory of the repository to scan. [default: /tmp/inspectra-help-dotnet-13c455db-afb06955]
  -s, --solution <solution>          Solution or project to scan. Discovered in --path when omitted.
  -v, --verbose                      Print what the load and the graph build are doing.
  -?, -h, --help                     Show help and usage information

Description:
  Delete each finding in memory and report the ones that break a compilation.

Usage:
  dotnet-deadcode oracle [options]

Options:
  --allow-partial            Measure the projects that loaded even when others did not (F#, Visual Basic, test projects with no tests). The figure is optimistic: uses in the projects that did not load are not seen.
  --include-public           Also check public members of libraries that nothing in the solution uses.
  -p, --path <path>          Directory of the repository to scan. [default: /tmp/inspectra-help-dotnet-13c455db-afb06955]
  --sample <sample>          How many findings to delete, spread evenly over the list. 0 checks all of them. [default: 50]
  -s, --solution <solution>  Solution or project to scan. Discovered in --path when omitted.
  -?, -h, --help             Show help and usage information

Description:
  Delete findings that compile without them, then rebuild; put everything back if the build breaks.

Usage:
  dotnet-deadcode fix [options]

Options:
  -p, --path <path>          Directory of the repository. [default: /tmp/inspectra-help-dotnet-13c455db-afb06955]
  -s, --solution <solution>  Solution or project to fix. Discovered in --path when omitted.
  --include-public           Also fix public members of libraries that nothing in the solution uses. Callers outside the solution break.
  --dry-run                  Say what would be deleted and write nothing.
  --allow-dirty              Fix a working tree with uncommitted changes. Without it a fix is always one `git checkout` from undone.
  -?, -h, --help             Show help and usage information
